name: ZEUS — SOCIAL EXECUTOR GITHUB AUTH — V5

parameters.jsCode: const h=$json.headers||{}; const b=$json.body||$json; const raw=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||''); const token=raw.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,'').trim(); return [{json:{token,run_id:String(b.run_id||''),sha:String(b.sha||''),repository:String(b.repository||''),action:String(b.action||'').trim().toLowerCase(),payload:b.payload||{},request_id:b.request_id||$execution.id,source:b.source||'github-actions'}}];

const e=$('Extrair envelope GitHub').first().json; const r=$json||{}; const ok=!!e.token && !!e.run_id && !!e.sha && e.repository==='ananzaguerra-tech/angtravelsolutions' && String(r.id||'')===e.run_id && String(r.head_sha||'')===e.sha && String(r.repository?.full_name||'')===e.repository; return [{json:{...e,authorized:ok,auth_status:ok?'PASS':'DENY',github_run_status:r.status||'',github_actor:r.actor?.login||'',token:undefined}}];

const e=$('Autorizar GitHub').first().json; const p=e.payload||{}; const pages=$json.data||[]; const wanted=String(p.page_name||p.brand||'').toLowerCase(); const page=pages.find(x=>String(x.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(wanted))||pages[0]; if(!page) return [{json:{request_id:e.request_id,status:'META_PAGE_NOT_FOUND',payload:p}}]; return [{json:{request_id:e.request_id,payload:p,page_id:page.id,page_name:page.name,page_access_token:page.access_token}}];

const base=$('Meta — Selecionar Página').first().json; const ig=$json.instagram_business_account||{}; const p=base.payload||{}; if(!ig.id) return [{json:{request_id:base.request_id,status:'INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND'}}]; return [{json:{request_id:base.request_id,instagram_business_account_id:ig.id,username:ig.username||'',page_access_token:base.page_access_token,format:String(p.format||'feed_4x5'),image_url:p.image_url||'',image_urls:Array.isArray(p.image_urls)?p.image_urls:[],caption:p.caption||''}}];

const x=$json; const ig=x.instagram_business_account_id, token=x.page_access_token, caption=x.caption||'', fmt=x.format; const base='https://graph.facebook.com/v23.0/'+ig; async function post(path,qs){return await $helpers.httpRequest({method:'POST',url:base+path,qs:{...qs,access_token:token},json:true});} try { let creation; if(fmt==='story'){ if(!x.image_url) return [{json:{request_id:x.request_id,status:'HOLD_MISSING_IMAGE_URL',format:fmt}}]; creation=await post('/media',{image_url:x.image_url,media_type:'STORIES'}); } else if(fmt==='carousel_3'){ if(!Array.isArray(x.image_urls)||x.image_urls.length<2) return [{json:{request_id:x.request_id,status:'HOLD_MISSING_CAROUSEL_MEDIA',format:fmt}}]; const children=[]; for(const u of x.image_urls){const c=await post('/media',{image_url:u,is_carousel_item:'true'}); if(!c.id) throw new Error('carousel child container failed'); children.push(c.id);} creation=await post('/media',{media_type:'CAROUSEL',children:children.join(','),caption}); } else { if(!x.image_url) return [{json:{request_id:x.request_id,status:'HOLD_MISSING_IMAGE_URL',format:fmt}}]; creation=await post('/media',{image_url:x.image_url,caption}); } if(!creation?.id) return [{json:{request_id:x.request_id,status:'FAILED_CREATE_CONTAINER',format:fmt,raw:creation||{}}}]; const pub=await post('/media_publish',{creation_id:creation.id}); return [{json:{request_id:x.request_id,area:'INSTAGRAM',status:pub?.id?'PUBLISHED':'FAILED',publication_id:pub?.id||'',format:fmt,username:x.username||'',raw:pub||{}}}]; } catch(e){ return [{json:{request_id:x.request_id,area:'INSTAGRAM',status:'FAILED',format:fmt,error:String(e.message||e)}}]; }
